item.title: Getting started with Speedle Cloud
item.description: Speedle Cloud is coming soon. Sign-in is not open on cloud.speedle.io yet, and authenticated authorization API calls are still being rolled out. The steps below describe the planned production workflow. Screenshots will be added after production sign-in opens; no mock-up images are used. 1. Sign in with GitHub or Google Open Speedle Cloud. When production sign-in opens, choose Sign in with GitHub or Sign in with Google. If you are creating a new account, explicitly confirm Create account.
